movelist.name: Haze
movelist.effect: The Combat Stages of the user and all Pokémon and Trainers in the encounter are set to their default state (usually 0).

movelist.name: Acrobatics
movelist.effect: If the user is not holding an item, Acrobatics instead has a Damage Base of 11 (3d10+10 / 27).

movelist.name: Mean Look
movelist.effect: The user casts a foul spell on the target, causing it to become Trapped and Slowed for the remainder of the encounter.

movelist.name: Poison Fang
movelist.effect: Poison Fang Badly Poisons the target on 17+.

movelist.name: Air Cutter
movelist.effect: Air Cutter is a Critical Hit on 18+.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.effect: The user gains a +2 Bonus to Stealth Checks, does not trigger Hazards, Blessings cannot be activated in response to its actions, and the user may bypass the effects of the move Substitute.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.effect: The user cannot be Flinched, and their Initiative cannot be unwillingly lowered by any effects.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.effect: The user may activate this Ability to use a Move with a Damage Base of 6 (before applying STAB or other modifiers) or lower as if it had the Priority keyword. If it hits, the target is Flinched and has a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for 1 full round.
